name: Petra Cliffs Day Camps (Classic Multi-Sport Camp & Climb On! Day Camp)
description_short: Adventure day camps from a Burlington climbing gym and mountaineering school, 9 AM to 4 PM with extended care 8 to 9 and 4 to 5. The Classic Multi-Sport Camp (ages 6 to 14, ten weeks) mixes rock climbing, kayaking, caving and challenge courses; Climb On! (ages 10 to 14, two weeks) is small-group outdoor rock climbing with professional guides. $575 per week; scholarships available.
activities: Challenge course at Bolton Adventure Center

sources.note: Day Camps page: 'Price: $575 per week', scholarships available; Classic Multi-Sport Camp ages 6-14, 2027 Weeks 1-10 (June 21 to August 27); Climb On! ages 10-14, 2027 dates July 26-30 and August 9-13; 105 Briggs St., Burlington, VT 05401, (802) 657-3872
Day Camp FAQs: hours 9-4, extended care 8-9 and 4-5, cancellation policy
2027 Registration & Scholarship Guide: registration opens Feb 1, 2027; camp director email camps@petracliffs.com

refund_policy_summary: 21 days or more before camp: full refund minus a $25 fee. 8 to 20 days: half refund minus $25. 7 days or fewer: no refund.
